title: Each Categories cell sums up its rule in short words
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, made right after tier A.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name no other tier uses, made right after tier B.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier D, with a name no other tier uses, made right after tier C.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier E, with a name no other tier uses, made right after tier D.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with two ranges, $0.00 to $100.00 and from $100.01: Default on Margin % 25 in both, tier A on Markup % 30 then Markup % 20, tier B on Markup % 30 then Margin % 20, tier C on % Off 5 in both, tier D on $ Off 5 in both, tier E on Same as previous tier.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • On category A's row, Default reads "25% margin" (one value in every range).
  • Tier A reads "% markup" (one type, different values).
  • Tier B reads "Mixed rules" (different types).
  • Tier C reads "5% off" and tier D reads "$5 off".
  • Tier E reads "Uses previous tier".
